citizen.name: Sable Tide
citizen.learned: Sable grew up in a coastal village and learned to navigate the sea from a young age.
citizen.lifestyle: Sable spends her days fishing and her evenings mending nets or socializing with other fishers.
citizen.currently: Sable is concerned about the recent changes in the tides and their impact on her livelihood.

relationships: Sable and Mara often fish together and share their daily catch.
Sable and Orion have been friends since childhood and often seek each other's advice.
Sable and Mira sometimes chat while mending their nets on the pier.
